prompt:
超写实日本车站候车区低机位手机抓拍摄影，竖版约 3:4。一名明确成年的东亚女性，25+，坐在老式城市 / 郊区车站站台的木质长椅边缘。摄影机位几乎贴近地面，位于人物双腿正前方偏右，使用约 20–24mm 手机超广角镜头向上强烈仰拍，完整拍到头部、身体、交叠双腿和长靴；靠近镜头的一条腿和靴子被明显放大，人物头部位于画面左上区域，形成夸张但真实的近大远小透视。

人物为自然丰满、下半身曲线明显的成年女性体型：肩部适中，胸部自然丰满，腰部收束，髋部圆润，大腿非常丰润柔软，小腿匀称。坐姿导致靠近镜头的大腿出现自然挤压和重量感，不要纸片身材，也不要夸张肥胖或健美肌肉感。

人物留乌黑色短发＋厚实碎齐刘海，长度约到下巴附近；两侧脸颊各有一缕弧形长碎发，后侧头发收拢成低位小发束 / 双侧低束发，整体带一点日系哥特风。肤色白皙，脸型偏小巧鹅蛋形，妆容清晰：黑色上扬眼线、浓密睫毛、浅灰棕眼影、淡粉腮红、低饱和红棕唇色。她略微低头看向镜头，神情平静、冷淡、有轻微距离感。

上身穿全黑色哥特 / 暗黑系修身长袖上衣，立领或高领设计，面料混合哑光缎面、仿皮和细密褶皱纹理，肩部略带蓬袖结构，胸前有纵向装饰线、细小金属链或银色配件。外层叠穿一件黑白粗花呢长款无袖外搭 / 开襟长马甲，黑、白、银灰纱线交织，表面带明显粗纺纹理和细碎反光，衣摆垂到座椅两侧。

下身穿黑色超短裙 / 黑色短裤式下装，大部分被上衣、外搭和坐姿遮住，只在大腿根部附近露出少量黑色边缘。双腿裸露，不穿丝袜，保留真实肤色和自然皮肤纹理。

坐姿严格还原：人物坐在长椅靠前位置，身体略向后靠，高位翘腿，一条腿完整搭在另一条腿上。上方大腿横跨画面中央，膝盖靠近镜头，形成非常明显的大腿前景；下方腿从座椅向下延伸。上方腿的小腿和靴子斜向画面右下角伸出，距离镜头最近的靴子尺寸明显更大；另一只靴子垂向画面下方中央。

脚穿黑色及膝皮革细高跟长靴，靴筒到膝盖下方，柔软黑色皮革带轻微自然褶皱，鞋头偏圆 / 微方圆头，鞋底较薄，细跟约7–9cm。右侧靠近镜头的长靴因为广角透视被明显放大，鞋跟和鞋底结构清楚；另一只靴子完整落在画面下方。

人物一只手自然放在腰腹或腿侧，大部分被上衣遮挡；另一只手位于身体后侧 / 座椅旁，不需要夸张手势。

场景为真实日本老式车站站台候车区：人物坐在带金属支架的木质长椅上，背景与顶部充满粉灰色 / 淡玫瑰色钢梁、铆钉、弧形雨棚结构和电气设备盒。画面右后方可以看到连续木质候车座椅和站台通道；地面为浅棕灰色防滑石材 / 水泥砖。

人物头顶和画面右上方有强烈的站台顶灯 / 自然天光混合高光，产生局部过曝和轻微镜头眩光。整体以车站冷白环境光＋偏暖自然光为主，黑色服装仍保留褶皱、粗花呢和皮革细节。

整体呈 真实手机超广角低机位抓拍＋日系暗黑时尚街拍质感：人物主体清晰，背景保持较多环境细节，轻微手机锐化、有限动态范围和少量噪点，不要商业棚拍感，不要大光圈奶油虚化。

重点锁定：明确成年东亚女性＋黑色短发厚刘海＋暗黑哥特妆容＋全黑长袖高领上衣＋黑白粗花呢长外搭＋黑色超短下装＋裸腿＋黑色及膝皮革细高跟长靴＋坐车站长椅＋高位翘腿＋一条丰满大腿横跨画面中央＋右侧长靴极靠近镜头＋20–24mm超广角极低机位仰拍＋粉灰色钢结构车站雨棚＋木质候车椅＋真实日系手机抓拍。

避免：长发、浅色服装、丝袜、网袜、裸足、短靴、平底鞋、运动鞋、站姿、普通平视角度、双腿并拢、腿部太纤细、低机位透视不明显、现代豪华车站、纯白摄影棚、强背景虚化、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余手指、多余腿、畸形鞋跟、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en: Hyper-realistic candid smartphone photography from a low camera angle in a Japanese train station waiting area, vertical aspect ratio around 3:4. A clearly adult East Asian female, 25+, sitting on the edge of a wooden bench on a vintage urban/suburban station platform. The camera position is almost touching the ground, situated directly in front of her legs slightly to the right, using an approx. 20–24mm smartphone ultra-wide lens shooting steeply upward, fully capturing her head, body, crossed legs, and tall boots; the leg and boot closest to the lens are significantly magnified, with the subject's head positioned in the upper-left area of the frame, creating an exaggerated yet realistic near-large-far-small perspective.  The subject has a naturally full-figured adult female physique with prominent lower-body curves: moderate shoulders, naturally full chest, cinched waist, rounded hips, very plush and soft thighs, and shapely calves. The seated posture creates natural compression and a sense of weight in the thigh closest to the lens; no wafer-thin body type, and no exaggerated obesity or bodybuilder muscularity.  She has jet-black short hair with thick, piecey straight bangs, roughly chin-length; on each cheek rests a curved, wispy long strand of hair, while the back hair is gathered into a low small ponytail / low twin bunches, giving an overall subtle Japanese goth vibe. Fair complexion, small-to-medium delicate oval face shape, well-defined makeup: winged black eyeliner, dense eyelashes, light grey-brown eyeshadow, soft pink blush, and low-saturation reddish-brown lip color. She tilts her head slightly down looking towards the camera, with a calm, aloof, and faintly distant expression.  On her upper body, she wears an all-black gothic/dark-aesthetic slim-fit long-sleeved top with a mandarin or high collar design, crafted from a mix of matte satin, faux leather, and fine pleated textures, with slightly puffed shoulder structures, and vertical decorative lines, tiny metal chains, or silver hardware across the chest. Layered over this is a black-and-white tweed long sleeveless duster / open-front long vest, interwoven with black, white, and silver-grey yarns, featuring a distinct coarse woven texture and subtle flecks of reflection, with the hem draping to the sides of the seat.  On her lower body, she wears black micro-shorts / a black mini skirt, mostly concealed by the top, vest, and seated posture, showing only a minimal black hem near the upper thighs. Legs are bare, no stockings or pantyhose, preserving realistic skin tone and natural skin texture.  The seated posture is strictly realized: sitting toward the front of the bench, body leaning slightly back, high cross-legged pose with one leg fully draped over the other. The upper thigh spans across the center of the frame with the knee close to the lens, forming a very prominent thigh foreground; the lower leg extends downward from the seat. The calf and boot of the upper leg stretch diagonally toward the bottom right corner of the frame, with the boot closest to the lens noticeably magnified in size; the other boot hangs downward toward the lower center of the frame.  Wearing knee-high black leather stiletto boots reaching just below the knee, made of soft black leather with subtle natural creasing, rounded or soft square-round toes, thin soles, and stilettos of around 7–9cm. The right boot closest to the lens is distinctly magnified by the wide-angle perspective, showing clear heel and sole construction; the other boot rests completely in the lower part of the frame.  One hand rests naturally near the waist/abdomen or the side of her leg, mostly obscured by the top; the other hand rests behind the body / beside the seat, without exaggerated hand gestures.  The setting is an authentic Japanese vintage train station platform waiting area: the subject sits on a wooden bench with metal brackets, with the background and ceiling filled with pinkish-grey / pale rose-tinted steel beams, rivets, curved canopy structures, and electrical equipment boxes. Continuous wooden waiting seats and platform corridors are visible in the right background; the floor consists of light brownish-grey anti-slip stone / concrete paving tiles.  Above the subject's head and in the upper right of the frame, strong platform overhead lights / natural daylight blend to create highlights, resulting in localized overexposure and subtle lens flares. The overall lighting is dominated by cool white station ambient light plus warm natural ambient light, while the black clothing retains creases, tweed, and leather details.  The overall aesthetic is authentic smartphone ultra-wide low-angle snapshot + Japanese dark street fashion texture: sharp main subject, background maintaining ample environmental details, slight smartphone sharpening, limited dynamic range, and a small amount of digital noise; no commercial studio feel, no large-aperture creamy background blur.  Key focuses: clearly adult East Asian female + black short hair with thick bangs + dark gothic makeup + all-black long-sleeved high-neck top + black-and-white tweed long sleeveless outerwear + black micro-mini bottom + bare legs + black knee-high leather stiletto boots + sitting on a station bench + high cross-legged pose + one full thigh spanning the center of the frame + right boot extremely close to the lens + 20–24mm ultra-wide-angle extremely low camera angle looking up + pinkish-grey steel structure station canopy + wooden waiting bench + authentic Japanese smartphone snapshot.  Avoid: long hair, light-colored clothing, pantyhose, fishnets, bare feet, ankle boots, flat shoes, sneakers, standing pose, normal eye-level angle, legs together, overly skinny legs, lack of low-angle perspective, modern luxury station, plain white studio background, heavy background blur/bokeh, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra fingers, extra legs, deformed heels, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Low-angle ultra-wide close-up photo of a gothic East Asian woman with crossed legs on a vintage Japanese station platform bench.

整体呈 真实手机超广角低机位抓拍＋日系暗黑时尚街拍质感：人物主体清晰，背景保持较多环境细节，轻微手机锐化、有限动态范围和少量噪点，不要商业棚拍感，不要大光圈奶油虚化。

重点锁定：明确成年东亚女性＋黑色短发厚刘海＋暗黑哥特妆容＋全黑长袖高领上衣＋黑白粗花呢长外搭＋黑色超短下装＋裸腿＋黑色及膝皮革细高跟长靴＋坐车站长椅＋高位翘腿＋一条丰满大腿横跨画面中央＋右侧长靴极靠近镜头＋20–24mm超广角极低机位仰拍＋粉灰色钢结构车站雨棚＋木质候车椅＋真实日系手机抓拍。

避免：长发、浅色服装、丝袜、网袜、裸足、短靴、平底鞋、运动鞋、站姿、普通平视角度、双腿并拢、腿部太纤细、低机位透视不明显、现代豪华车站、纯白摄影棚、强背景虚化、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余手指、多余腿、畸形鞋跟、水印和乱码文字。

translations.zh: 超写实日本车站候车区低机位手机抓拍摄影，竖版约 3:4。一名明确成年的东亚女性坐在老式车站木质长椅上，超广角仰拍，黑色哥特风高领上衣配黑白粗花呢长马甲与及膝皮细高跟长靴，高位翘腿透视夸张。
translations.en: Photorealistic ultra-wide low-angle snapshot of an adult East Asian woman seated on a wooden bench at a Japanese train station platform, wearing a gothic black top, tweed vest, and black knee-high stiletto boots.
